crossRefs.note: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also…
I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will…
But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable…
Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God.
Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
His mouth is sweetness; yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the…
Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands…
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun…
The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
